//: dev-notests -- the dev world with the test machinery left out. Was the `--notests` flag
A subtraction, so it is spelled as one: everything EXCEPT the harness part. That single
exclusion is what drops the js/tests link, BUILDFLAG_LOAD_TESTS, the two tests-repo build
gates, FileSaver/JSZip and the harness pointer icons -- one fact, not six flags.
⚠ It keeps `macros`, which is measured behaviour and not an oversight: the old --notests tree
shipped the macro engine too (it is authoring machinery under src/, and it is the harness that
makes a build test-CAPABLE). A profile that wants neither says {"allExcept": ["harness",
Nothing in the workspace builds this automatically -- it is a hand-typed check that the product
still stands up with the test machinery gone, short of a full production build.
